description: DC-link voltage state: electrolytic+film link capacitor with a bench supply model (CV with series resistance, source/sink current limits, optional CV clamp. Bus integrates C dv/dt = i_supply - i_inverter.

inputPorts.name: P_Draw
inputPorts.description: Total electrical power drawn from the link, W (machine air-gap + losses, positive = leaves the link).

outputPorts.name: I_Link
outputPorts.description: Current INTO the link, A (regen-feed convention, matches recordings).

outputPorts.name: P_Link
outputPorts.description: Power INTO the link, W (regen-feed convention).

SeriesR_mOhm.description: Bench supply effective series resistance, milliohm.

SinkLimit_A.description: Sink current limit (down-programmer / Sorensen class), A.

CvClamp_V.description: Optional CV clamp setpoint, V (Chroma). 0 = disabled.
